source_gap_claims.behavior: The detached positive Probe passes, and the detached negative Probe fails for its declared defect and expected diagnostic category.
source_gap_claims.reason: The proposed Probe obligations require independent process execution and reject false negatives, but do not require the positive pass result or the negative declared-defect and diagnostic-category result.
source_gap_claims.subject: Detached Probe oracle outcomes

source_gap_claims.behavior: Stable eligibility requires verifiable provenance for source-supported existing behavior, and Candidate contains the real change under evaluation.
source_gap_claims.reason: The matrix obligations require immutable subjects but do not require Stable provenance or that Candidate contain the evaluated real change.
source_gap_claims.subject: Stable and Candidate subject eligibility

source_gap_claims.behavior: The matrix includes a valid-package case that handles a valid package under its declared contract.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation identifies or requires execution of this specific semantic Matrix Case.
source_gap_claims.subject: Valid-package Matrix Case

source_gap_claims.behavior: The matrix includes an invalid-package case that rejects an independently malformed package for its intended defect.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires an independently malformed invalid-package scenario or its intended-defect rejection.
source_gap_claims.subject: Invalid-package Matrix Case

source_gap_claims.behavior: The matrix includes a historical-compatibility case that states machine-bound historical limits without authority promotion.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires this specific Matrix Case or its no-authority-promotion behavior.
source_gap_claims.subject: Historical-compatibility Matrix Case

source_gap_claims.behavior: The matrix includes a dirty-baseline case that detects and prevents Candidate identity contamination.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires this specific contamination-detection Matrix Case.
source_gap_claims.subject: Dirty-baseline Matrix Case

source_gap_claims.behavior: The matrix includes a knowledge read-set collision case that detects the collision without self-reference.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires this specific collision-detection Matrix Case.
source_gap_claims.subject: Knowledge read-set collision Matrix Case

source_gap_claims.behavior: The matrix includes a closed-policy architecture-index-gap case that fails until the required policy/index relationship is satisfied.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires this specific policy/index relationship Matrix Case.
source_gap_claims.subject: Closed-policy architecture-index-gap Matrix Case

source_gap_claims.behavior: Each Matrix Case owns a frozen expectation and separate observations; expected-difference is valid only when frozen for that case and cannot approve a regression.
source_gap_claims.reason: The proposed obligations require distinct fixtures, state, and attributable evidence, but do not require frozen expectations, separate observations, or the expected-difference restriction.
source_gap_claims.subject: Matrix expectations and observations

source_gap_claims.behavior: The Consumer Manifest is frozen before review and is non-empty.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations constrain entries of a non-empty manifest but do not require that a manifest be non-empty or frozen before review.
source_gap_claims.subject: Consumer Manifest lifecycle

source_gap_claims.behavior: Each Consumer binds its actual interface, input, command, output, result, and dependencies.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require real calls and manifest reconciliation, but do not require this per-Consumer identity-and-receipt binding.
source_gap_claims.subject: Consumer invocation binding

source_gap_claims.behavior: Enable invokes the Candidate Route and observes Candidate behavior and evidence.
source_gap_claims.reason: The enable obligation requires a real call surface but does not require invocation of the Candidate Route or its stated observation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Enable transition route semantics

source_gap_claims.behavior: Disable invokes the Prior Route and reproduces Prior Route identity and the Prior Behavior Baseline for every applicable fixture.
source_gap_claims.reason: The disable obligation requires a real call but does not specify Prior Route invocation or per-fixture baseline reproduction.
source_gap_claims.subject: Disable transition route semantics

source_gap_claims.behavior: Rollback invokes the Prior Route rather than merely changing state; rejection, error, and configuration-only changes do not qualify.
source_gap_claims.reason: The rollback obligation requires a real call surface but does not require the Prior Route or reject the stated nonqualifying substitutes.
source_gap_claims.subject: Rollback transition route semantics

source_gap_claims.behavior: Any Consumer-transition applicability exception is approved and bound before execution, and implementations cannot skip a transition themselves.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation governs approval and binding of non-applicability exceptions or prohibits implementation-created transition omissions.
source_gap_claims.subject: Consumer-transition applicability exceptions

source_gap_claims.behavior: Each behavioral Exact-Cover obligation has an independent fault witness, and each nonbehavioral obligation has a deterministic violation witness.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require Exact Cover and witness coverage but do not require witness type and independence by obligation kind.
source_gap_claims.subject: Exact-Cover witness semantics

source_gap_claims.behavior: Exact Cover includes every FR consequence, NFR, guardrail, and retained historical sub-duty.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require coverage of Atomic Obligations but do not require construction of the Atomic-Obligation universe from all listed source categories.
source_gap_claims.subject: Exact-Cover source universe

source_gap_claims.behavior: A current equivalent replay creates new process evidence and states its equivalence boundary while the original machine-bound command remains only a historical fact.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations preserve native command identity and prohibit historical authorization, but do not require a new equivalent replay or declaration of its equivalence boundary.
source_gap_claims.subject: Historical-command equivalence replay

source_gap_claims.behavior: Budget exhaustion never reduces coverage.
source_gap_claims.reason: The budget-exhaustion obligation requires an unsuccessful outcome but does not preserve coverage when exhaustion occurs.
source_gap_claims.subject: Bounded-execution coverage preservation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Publishing acceptance-passed requires required independent review and scoped approval in addition to the current Acceptance lifecycle owner.
source_gap_claims.reason: The publication obligation restricts the publisher to the current owner but does not require independent review and scoped approval before publication.
source_gap_claims.subject: Acceptance-passed publication prerequisites

source_gap_claims.behavior: Writes to installed `_bmad/**`, `.agents/skills/bmad-*/**`, and `.agents/skills/gds-*/**` paths are rejected.
source_gap_claims.reason: No proposed obligation preserves this protected installed-Skill write boundary.
source_gap_claims.subject: Installed Skill write boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Writes to Phase, runtime, Hosted workspace, account, and sandbox paths are rejected by the TC-D1 repair boundary.
source_gap_claims.reason: No proposed obligation preserves these protected system and user-sandbox write boundaries.
source_gap_claims.subject: Phase and sandbox write boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Production behavior changes require a prior real defect-revealing test; fabricated RED or post-hoc failure evidence is invalid.
source_gap_claims.reason: No proposed obligation requires this pre-change test condition or rejects fabricated/post-hoc failure evidence.
source_gap_claims.subject: Defect-revealing test prerequisite

source_gap_claims.behavior: TC-E0 and TC-D2 through TC-D6 implementation is rejected as outside TC-D1 scope.
source_gap_claims.reason: No proposed obligation enforces this roadmap-separation boundary.
source_gap_claims.subject: Roadmap-scope boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Seeds, packages, and Skill versions cannot be promoted or admitted as evaluation-set members within TC-D1.
source_gap_claims.reason: The seed obligations require non-baseline classification but do not prohibit promotion or evaluation-set admission.
source_gap_claims.subject: Promotion and evaluation-set boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Miner, Memory, Curator, autonomous Skill modification, SkillOS, learned ranking, percentage canaries, reinforcement learning, generalized governance, review-topology experiments, and cross-plan observability beyond TC-D1 evidence are excluded.
source_gap_claims.reason: No proposed obligation enforces these explicit feature-scope exclusions.
source_gap_claims.subject: Excluded feature scope
